title: Scaling Luxury Horology E-Commerce to $42M ARR
tagline: Brand repositioning and high-net-worth acquisition architecture across Dubai & North America.
challenge: Aurum Atelier had exquisite handcrafted timepieces but was suffering from rising customer acquisition costs and low digital trust among ultra-high-net-worth collectors in the GCC.
approach: We engineered an editorial digital experience combined with private concierge remarketing flows, targeted search arbitrage, and cinematic programmatic media.
outcome: In 14 months, direct-to-consumer sales grew from $9.5M to over $42M, establishing Aurum Atelier as a premier digital-first horology maison.

title: Dominating Enterprise Digital Health in North America

approach: We deployed an account-based growth framework, high-authority research papers, and technical SEO infrastructure converting hospital CIOs at peak decision cycles.
outcome: Closed 28 Fortune 500 healthcare provider contracts within 3 quarters and cut sales cycle velocity by 38 days.

title: Institutional Capital Acquisition for Greentech Infrastructure
